guide_text:
# Senior backend interview preparation

A twelve-week program for senior backend or backend-leaning platform and product roles. Work is ordered by dependency: delivery and system-design foundations in Weeks 1–3; concrete backend technologies in Weeks 4–6; reusable architecture patterns and full-design application in Weeks 7–9; interview simulation and target-company calibration in Weeks 10–12.

Each week reserves twelve focused hours across system design, coding, behavioral preparation, and plan-local closed-book retrieval. Global Devmax card reviews continue separately in Today and never determine Study Plan progress. Coding execution and full system designs happen outside the conversational review flow. Every external practice session ends with a gap harvest, and readiness is based on observed mock performance rather than card scores.
